import { customizeTable } from "@rebasepro/cms";
import type { gpxFiles } from "../../../backend/schema/gpx_files";

// A board over "visibility" fits this table, but a board needs a text column to keep each card's order in. Add one, then declare kanban: { columnField: "visibility", orderField: "<that column>" }.
export const gpxFilesCms = customizeTable<typeof gpxFiles>("gpx_files", {
    display: {
        title: "name"
    },
    listFields: ["id", "name", "visibility", "timestamp", "visible", "inserted"],
    fields: {
        name: {
            multiline: true
        },
        description: {
            multiline: true
        }
    },
    fieldOrder: [
        "id",
        "name",
        "visibility",
        "timestamp",
        "visible",
        "inserted",
        "size",
        "latitude",
        "longitude",
        "user",
        "description"
    ]
});
